LanguageData.TietoTree.SettingsEscapeChance: Escape chance per tied prisoner per day: {0}
LanguageData.TietoTree.SettingsEscapeChanceDesc: The chance that a prisoner tied to a tree breaks free.
LanguageData.TietoTree.SettingsEscapeChanceExplain: This is a chance per tied prisoner per in-game day (60,000 ticks). Each tied prisoner gets one roll per day, at a random time of that day. At 0% a tied prisoner never escapes; at 100% a tied prisoner escapes at the next scheduled roll.
LanguageData.TietoTree.SettingsDebugLoggingDesc: Write extra diagnostic messages about tying and untying prisoners to the log.
LanguageData.TietoTree.TreeNoLongerValid: that tree or spot is no longer available
LanguageData.TietoTree.TieToTreeChance: Tie {0} to a tree... ({2} chance of success)
LanguageData.TietoTree.CommandUntieDesc: Have a colonist untie this prisoner from the tree. The prisoner stays a prisoner.
LanguageData.TietoTree.NoOneToUntie: No colonist can reach this prisoner to untie them.
LanguageData.TietoTree.MessageBrokeFree: {0} broke free from the tree and is trying to escape!
